description: Repository Git policy checks shared with Claude Code.

hooks.command: if root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); then python3 "$root/.claude/hooks/prevent-direct-push.py"; else printf 'Codex policy hook skipped: no Git worktree\n' >&2; fi
if root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); then python3 "$root/.claude/hooks/require-preflight.py"; else printf 'Codex policy hook skipped: no Git worktree\n' >&2; fi
if root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); then python3 "$root/.claude/hooks/validate-branch-name.py"; else printf 'Codex policy hook skipped: no Git worktree\n' >&2; fi
if root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); then python3 "$root/.claude/hooks/update-changelog-before-pr.py"; else printf 'Codex policy hook skipped: no Git worktree\n' >&2; fi
